messages:
daniel (procurement): Heads up — FRA customs flagged an RMA shipment (AWB: FRA-9981-XL). It's holding 24 H100s we had earmarked for eu-dedicated backfill. Need options: short-term float, expedited release, or consolidated replacement. Any quick wins?
maria (ops): Oof. How long is customs saying? Do we have manifest + invoice mismatch?
kevin (logistics): I pulled the scan, says 'missing commercial invoice' and mismatch on HS code. Carrier can refile if we provide corrected CI within 24h. AWB listed below.
kevin (logistics): ```AWB: FRA-9981-XL
Pieces: 24
Models: H100-PCIe
Serials: SN1001,SN1002,SN1003,...,SN1024
Issue: commercial invoice HS 8471 vs 8542 (wrong)
```
nexasupply (vendor): We can: 1) Reissue CI with correct HS (we'll need purchase order and declared value approved), 2) Do an air uplift from our EU buffer (we have 8 usable loaners in NL) for same-day dispatch, 3) Offer a US pool float (up to 12 units) ETA 72h to FRA if customer ok with cross-border. Expedited clearance service + customs brokerage is +€1,200 flat.

nexasupply (vendor): Note on pricing: air uplift for replacements is extra €450/unit. US float incurs import duties on arrival, we can handle DDP but cost to Redwood will be ~€600/unit.

maria (ops): Short-term ask: Can vendor send 8 NL loaners now and refile CI to clear the rest in parallel? That buys us capacity.
daniel (procurement): Sounds good. Also open question: can we ask for depot repair credit for time-in-transit? The RMA was merchant return due to DOA, the customs delay is vendor-side admin. We should push for a waiver on depot fees.
nexasupply (vendor): We can expedite 8 loaners from NL today. For the remaining 16, refile CI immediately but customs clearance is still subject to inspection — typical 1–3 days. We can offer a one-time depot fee credit of €100/unit for delays >48h, not for customs fines.
kevin (logistics): If we accept 8 loaners, ops, which routes do you want them to be staged to? eu-west-1 pool or DE-dedicated rack?
maria (ops): Stage to DE-dedicated. We'll tag them as float and mark throughput lanes. Also request serial-level tracking so we can route to canary hosts.
daniel (procurement): Vendor — please attach corrected CI and a scanned commercial invoice to the thread and confirm AWB for the loaners. Also email legal to start claims if fines applied.
nexasupply (vendor): CI attached via carrier portal (link: https://carrier.example/ci/FRA-9981). Loaner AWB: NL-4422-EXP ETA 2024-08-14 18:00 CEST. I'll add serials once boxed.
vendor-bot: Shipment NL-4422-EXP status: BOOKED -> PICKED UP (14:03 CEST).
maria (ops): Great. @kevin monitor customs updates and @daniel loop legal if any extra charges. If clearance stalls beyond 72h we need to request full credit and discuss replacement from our US pool. :thumbsup:
daniel (procurement): One more thing — can we get a provisional invoice showing the waived depot fee for our finance team so we can reconcile accruals?
nexasupply (vendor): We'll issue a provisional credit memo if delay >48h. Will confirm once clearance complete.
kevin (logistics): I'll update the capacity tracker and flag the eu-dedicated forecast to show -24 until loaners arrive.
maria (ops): Thanks team. If loaners arrive on schedule we should be able to avoid customer impact. Keep updates short here.
